name: Razzmic Berry
lede: Razzmic Berry is a dusty wine purple, named with the generic "berry" fruit suffix rather than any one named fruit.

sections.title: A berry name without a named berry
sections.body:
Our only source for this entry is Wikipedia, which gives the hex value and the "berry" ending but does not say which berry, if any, the color is meant to recall [1]. "Razzmic" plays on "raspberry" by sound, but that link is not confirmed in the sources here [1]. The color sits near enough to several other names that our library lists them as close matches from other systems: Patricia, an ISCC-NBS name via Maerz and Paul first recorded in 1924, and Phlox Purple, first recorded in 1886 [1].

Its nearest named neighbor is [[plum]], 2.5 units away and more vivid [2]. [[razzmic-berry]] sits almost the same shade, just 3.3 units off, and the library's own near-duplicate crowd name, "Purplish", is closer still at 0.9 units [1][2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive matches this color across even a small share of its canvas, as photographed [3]. That absence describes this archive, not painting generally; a muted purple like this is exactly the kind of color varnish and fading can shift away from a match [3].
